title: Search doesn’t stop at the click.
text: Search doesn’t stop at the click. 10× more Google clicks Cited in comparisons Then Pepys took off THE CASE FILE / OWNED PRODUCTS Two products. Three views of visibility and use. Every claim has its own source, date, and limit. Monthly clicks rose from 96 in April to 988 in August 2026. Search impressions rose from 44,149 to 244,510 in the same period. From the June public launch to the week of September 13, the signup curve bent sharply upward. This is product growth, separate from QuoteSweep’s Google result and not attributed to search. Separately, 3,828 distinct users completed 7,913 transcriptions in September. Google Search brought 330 clicks in the Aug 31–Sep 28 window – one piece of the story, not an explanation for all signups. Search Console for Google discovery. Repeated captures for answer context. PostHog for product use. Different instruments, different questions.
provenance: Published copy from seo-ai-search/index.html; verify live publication separately

title: Find the gap. Make the answer better.
text: Find the gap. Make the answer better. Can Google reach it? What are buyers asking? Who gets named or cited? Did anything move? WHAT I LOOK AT Search work should be specific enough to ship and measured enough to question. Crawling, indexing, page structure, internal links and the technical problems hiding good work. Map commercial questions to pages and product paths, without filling the site with interchangeable articles. Use a defined set of prompts and repeated checks to see what AI answers use, then trace the source pages. Track dated changes against Search Console, search results and on-site actions. Keep impressions, clicks and revenue separate.
